body.html: Suansin Garden Hotel is a 3-star midrange property in the Rahaeng area of Mueang Tak district, Tak province, sitting right on Phahonyothin Road / the Asia Highway · Its selling point is exactly what the name promises: a genuinely leafy green garden, a quiet private atmosphere, and rooms more spacious than many in-town hotels · Drivers passing through Tak who want a one-night stopover, families visiting or running errands in town, and anyone after a big, quiet room at a midrange price tend to pick this place because it's good value and easy to reach off the main road.

Rooms range from a Superior Double with a king bed and a Superior Twin with two single beds, both around 24 sqm, up to a Deluxe and a large 70 sqm Family Room that sleeps a whole family · The compliment that comes up most is that rooms are spacious, clean, comfortable to sleep in, and quiet and private · Every room has AC, a TV, an en-suite bathroom with hot water and Wi-Fi · The trade-off to know up front is that the room style is fairly plain — this is an older property, not a brand-new boutique with modern design · It's a stay that stands out for space and quiet rather than for style or design.
"Really spacious, clean and quiet, with a lovely garden to walk in. Friendly staff, easy parking, close to a mall and restaurants — great value for a stopover."

Facilities are pitched right for a midrange place with a garden · There's plenty of free parking, free Wi-Fi, an on-site restaurant, breakfast, and a green garden to sit and stroll in · What many guests like is the calm, private feel — it's not as busy as a town-centre hotel, so it suits travellers who actually want to rest · The limitations reviews mention are that there's no swimming pool, and breakfast is fairly plain with a small menu, with some guests finding the coffee not strong enough · Overall the facilities lean toward enough-for-the-job and quiet rather than the full spread of a big resort.

The location is in the Rahaeng area, Nam Ruem subdistrict, right on Phahonyothin Road / the Asia Highway · It's about 2 km from the King Rama Bicentennial Bridge (Tak's suspension bridge), close to the King Taksin the Great shrine and Tak town, with a mall and restaurants nearby · The plus is easy access on and off the main road, ideal if you're driving through or using Tak as a base before heading north or to Mae Sot · The thing to weigh is that it sits on a main road, so some rooms catch traffic noise — ask for an inner room facing the garden for more quiet · The overall score is around 8.4 from 36 real reviews on Trip.com, and it holds a Travellers' Choice award on Tripadvisor.

Honestly, Suansin Garden Hotel sells space and quiet, not newness or design · The rooms are plainly styled in an older property, there's no pool, breakfast is simple, and it sits on a main road where you'll want to factor in traffic noise · If you're expecting a brand-new boutique with a pool and the full service spread, this won't be it · But if you see it as a spacious, clean, quiet room with a green garden and free parking, in a spot that's easy on and off the main road near central Tak, at a midrange price — it does the job well and is genuinely good value for families and stopover travellers.

A tip from following the reviews here: if you're travelling as a group or family, book the 70 sqm Family Room — it's nearly three times the size of a standard room for only a little more · Ask for an inner room facing the garden to stay quieter than the roadside rooms · If you plan to have breakfast, expect a simple spread, or just head to a restaurant in town nearby · Having your own car is the most convenient, since the location suits drivers, and always compare prices directly on Agoda and Booking before you book, as rates move with the season and promotions.

honestSummary: Suansin Garden Hotel is a midrange property that fits travellers who want spacious, clean, quiet rooms with a green garden and free parking, in a spot that's easy on and off the main road near central Tak · The room size and the quiet are genuine strengths, backed by an 8.4 score and a Travellers' Choice award — but accept that the style is fairly plain in an older property, there's no pool, breakfast is simple, and it sits on a main road where you'll want to factor in traffic noise.
honestChecks: If you want a brand-new boutique with modern design and a pool — this is a plainly styled older property with no pool → choose a newer in-town hotel if design and facilities matter most.

If you're a light sleeper sensitive to traffic noise — the hotel sits on the Asia Highway and some rooms catch road noise → ask for an inner room facing the garden, flagging it at booking or check-in.
If you need a full breakfast and complete facilities — breakfast is plain with a small menu and on some packages only → check the package when booking, or head to a restaurant in town nearby.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Suansin Garden Hotel Tak

faq.q: Where is Suansin Garden Hotel and what's nearby?
faq.a: It's at 8/7 M.8 Phahonyothin Road, Nam Ruem subdistrict, Mueang Tak district, Tak province, in the Rahaeng area on the Asia Highway · Wat Phai Lom is about 0.7 km away, the King Rama Bicentennial Bridge about 2 km, and the King Taksin the Great shrine about 2.5 km · There's a mall and restaurants nearby with easy access to the main road, ideal for drivers passing through or using Tak as a base.

faq.q: How much does Suansin Garden Hotel cost and what rooms are there?
faq.a: Prices start from about ฿650/night for a Superior Double or Superior Twin of around 24 sqm · There's a Deluxe at around ฿800 and a 70 sqm Family Room for families at around ฿1,200 · Rates move with the season and promotions, so always compare across platforms before booking.

faq.q: Who is Suansin Garden Hotel best for?
faq.a: It's great for families, road-trippers stopping over, and visitors running errands in Tak who want spacious, clean, quiet rooms with a green garden at a midrange price · It suits drivers with their own car thanks to easy main-road access and free parking, especially groups who want a big family room.

faq.q: What are the rooms and atmosphere like at Suansin Garden Hotel?
faq.a: Spacious, clean rooms with comfortable beds, a quiet private feel and a leafy green garden are the compliments that come up most · Standard rooms are around 24 sqm, with a large 70 sqm Family Room available · The trade-off is a fairly plain room style in an older property — not brand-new or modern design — and there's no swimming pool.

faq.q: Does Suansin Garden Hotel have Wi-Fi and breakfast?
faq.a: Yes — free Wi-Fi, free parking and an on-site restaurant · Breakfast is available on some packages, but several reviews note it's fairly plain with a small menu and the coffee not strong enough for some. If you want more variety, there are restaurants in town nearby. Check whether your package includes breakfast when booking.

faq.q: Are Suansin Garden Hotel's review scores reliable?
faq.a: Suansin Garden Hotel has an overall score of around 8.4 from 36 real reviews on Trip.com and holds a Travellers' Choice award on Tripadvisor · Its strengths are spacious rooms, cleanliness and a quiet garden atmosphere, making it a solid midrange pick for spacious, good-value rooms in Tak, especially for families and stopover travellers.
